Messages.Author: Ferenci Stefan
Messages.Body:
Can i play a claws of the death at long range making my hand damage agg just
to cycle cards?
If yes, can i play a rötschreck then. i would say yes because the card says
play when attempting too use agg damage?
If my opponent played skin of night at the beginning of the combat can i
play agg damage and rötschreck?
thanks stefan

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Ferenci Stefan" <a950...@unet.univie.ac.at> wrote:
> Can i play a claws of the death at long range making my hand damage
> agg just to cycle cards?

Sure.

> If yes, can i play a rötschreck then. i would say yes because the card
> says play when attempting too use agg damage?

No, because card text goes on to say "against a vampire."
At long range, your hand strike is against the air in front of
you, not against a vampire.

> If my opponent played skin of night at the beginning of the combat
> can i play agg damage and rötschreck?

If you attempt to use the agg damage against him, yes.

> > > the card says play when attempting too use agg damage?
> >
> > No, because card text goes on to say "against a vampire."
> > At long range, your hand strike is against the air in front of
> > you, not against a vampire.
> >
> not wanting to argue but, imho i still attempt to use agg damage but i
> am simply too far away,

Correct. You are attempting to use agg damage, but are too far
away to use it "against a vampire", which is required by Rötschreck's
card text, as I noted above, which leads to the conclusion that
you cannot play it (having failed to meet the requirements for doing
so).

> can i play agg damage and rotschreck against a vamp who is immune to
> agg damage?

So long as you meet the requirements (i.e., you attempt "to use
aggravated damaged against a vampire"), you can play the card.
